# 3D asset credits

`RobotExpressive.glb` is retained as an unused legacy asset. It is the CC0 1.0 model by Tomás Laulhé, modified for the Three.js examples by Don McCurdy.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/eba30de865cfbf31ac736f792defd9a60ff28d57/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive
License: CC0 1.0 Universal


## Metro models

metro-driving-car.glb is the Metro driving car from the Modern Rail and Metro Network pack. It includes open, close, and wheel-roll animations.
Source: https://3dassets.dev/assets/modern-rail-and-metro-network-metro-driving-car-d7d433ca
Model: https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/13672/v1/model.glb
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

metro-platform-side.glb is the Side platform module from the same CC0 pack.
Source: https://3dassets.dev/assets/modern-rail-and-metro-network-side-platform-module-401b4ffd
Model: https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/13697/v1/model.glb
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
